title: Application Security Engineer Roadmap
summary: A concise, hands‑on plan to solidify security fundamentals, master core engineering skills, build a showcase portfolio, and prepare for job or client work. Each phase balances learning, practice, and real‑world output.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Lay the security groundwork and communication basics.

milestones.title: Secure coding fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can write code that resists common OWASP Top 10 flaws.

tasks.title: Read OWASP Top 10 overview
tasks.description: Study the OWASP Top 10 page on OWASP.org to understand each category and example attacks.

tasks.title: Complete secure‑coding module on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the 'Secure Coding Practices' section, answering the embedded quizzes.

tasks.title: Refactor a sample script to fix XSS
tasks.description: Take a vulnerable JavaScript snippet and apply output‑encoding to eliminate cross‑site scripting.

tasks.title: Document lessons learned
tasks.description: Write a one‑page summary of the fixes you made and why they matter.

milestones.title: Auth and cryptography basics
milestones.outcome: Can choose appropriate hashing, encryption, and authentication mechanisms for a service.

tasks.title: Watch Crypto 101 on YouTube (Khan Academy)
tasks.description: Focus on symmetric vs asymmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures.

tasks.title: Read MDN guide on Web Crypto API
tasks.description: Understand how browsers expose cryptographic primitives and how to use them safely.

tasks.title: Implement password hashing with bcrypt in a demo app
tasks.description: Add bcrypt hashing to a login endpoint and verify password checks.

tasks.title: Explain why salting matters in a short note
tasks.description: Write a brief explanation of salt and its role in protecting stored passwords.

milestones.title: Developer communication
milestones.outcome: Can convey security findings clearly to engineers and stakeholders.

tasks.title: Read Google’s Security Incident Response guide
tasks.description: Identify best practices for reporting and collaborating on security issues.

tasks.title: Draft a mock security advisory for a SQL injection
tasks.description: Write a concise advisory that includes impact, remediation steps, and code examples.

tasks.title: Practice a 5‑minute security walkthrough with a peer
tasks.description: Present the advisory and field questions, focusing on clarity and actionable advice.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback and note improvement areas
tasks.description: Summarize peer feedback and plan adjustments for future communications.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop threat modelling, code review, and CI security tooling expertise.

milestones.title: Threat modelling practice
milestones.outcome: Can create STRIDE‑based threat models for small applications.

tasks.title: Read Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool overview
tasks.description: Understand the STRIDE methodology and asset identification process.

tasks.title: Model an open‑source note‑taking app on paper
tasks.description: Identify data flows, trust boundaries, and threats using STRIDE.

tasks.title: Validate model with OWASP Threat Modeling Cheat Sheet
tasks.description: Cross‑check each identified threat against the cheat sheet for completeness.

tasks.title: Summarize findings in a one‑page report
tasks.description: Document the top three risks and suggested mitigations.

milestones.title: Secure code review techniques
milestones.outcome: Can conduct effective security‑focused code reviews.

tasks.title: Read GitHub’s Secure Code Review guide
tasks.description: Learn checklist items and reviewer responsibilities.

tasks.title: Perform a security review on a public repo pull request
tasks.description: Apply the checklist to a real PR on GitHub and note findings.

tasks.title: Write review comments for three issues
tasks.description: Craft clear, actionable comments for each security finding you discovered.

tasks.title: Reflect on reviewer feedback loop
tasks.description: Note how the author responded and what you could improve in your comments.

milestones.title: CI security tooling integration
milestones.outcome: Can embed automated security checks into a CI pipeline.

tasks.title: Watch Snyk CI integration tutorial on YouTube
tasks.description: Follow the step‑by‑step video to add Snyk to a GitHub Actions workflow.

tasks.title: Add Trivy scan to a sample Docker build
tasks.description: Configure Trivy in a GitHub Actions file to fail on high‑severity findings.

tasks.title: Run the pipeline and record results
tasks.description: Execute the workflow, capture the scan output, and note any vulnerabilities detected.

tasks.title: Document integration steps for teammates
tasks.description: Create a short markdown guide describing how to enable the scans in new projects.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate the core skills.

milestones.title: Threat model of an open‑source app
milestones.outcome: Portfolio includes a complete, documented threat model.

tasks.title: Select a popular open‑source web app
tasks.description: Choose a repo with clear architecture, such as an issue‑tracker demo.

tasks.title: Create a detailed STRIDE model
tasks.description: Map data flows, trust boundaries, and list threats with mitigations.

tasks.title: Publish the model on GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Render the model as a PDF and host it with a brief project README.

tasks.title: Write a 200‑word project summary
tasks.description: Explain the app, scope, and key security insights for recruiters.

milestones.title: CI pipeline with security checks
milestones.outcome: Portfolio shows a working CI pipeline that fails on security issues.

tasks.title: Fork a simple Node.js starter repo
tasks.description: Create your own copy to experiment without affecting the original.

tasks.title: Add Snyk and Trivy steps to GitHub Actions
tasks.description: Configure both tools, set severity thresholds, and commit the workflow file.

tasks.title: Introduce a known vulnerable dependency
tasks.description: Add an outdated package to trigger a security alert in the pipeline.

tasks.title: Record pipeline run and annotate findings
tasks.description: Capture screenshots and write notes on how the pipeline responded.

milestones.title: Secure‑coding guide for a language
milestones.outcome: Portfolio contains a concise guide with code examples and best practices.

tasks.title: Choose a language you code in most
tasks.description: Select Python, JavaScript, or Go based on your experience.

tasks.title: Draft sections for injection, auth, and crypto
tasks.description: Write short explanations and safe code snippets for each topic.

tasks.title: Publish the guide as a GitHub repo README
tasks.description: Create a public repository and format the guide with markdown.

tasks.title: Share the repo link on LinkedIn and note feedback
tasks.description: Post the project, monitor comments, and record any suggestions for improvement.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance knowledge, polish interview readiness, and start job hunting or client outreach.

milestones.title: Advanced auth and crypto patterns
milestones.outcome: Can design secure authentication flows and choose appropriate algorithms.

tasks.title: Read OWASP Authentication Cheat Sheet
tasks.description: Identify recommended practices for password storage, MFA, and session management.

tasks.title: Implement JWT with rotating signing keys
tasks.description: Create a demo service that issues and validates JWTs using a key‑rotation schedule.

tasks.title: Test token revocation and expiration
tasks.description: Write automated tests that verify revoked tokens are rejected and expirations work.

tasks.title: Summarize trade‑offs of symmetric vs asymmetric tokens
tasks.description: Write a brief note comparing performance, security, and use cases.

milestones.title: Interview prep and communication polish
milestones.outcome: Can articulate security concepts clearly in interviews and client meetings.

tasks.title: Review common security interview questions on Glassdoor
tasks.description: Collect at least ten typical questions and draft concise answers.

tasks.title: Conduct a mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Answer the questions aloud, focusing on structure and clarity.

tasks.title: Refine answers based on feedback
tasks.description: Edit your written answers to be tighter and more impact‑driven.

tasks.title: Record a short video explaining a recent threat model
tasks.description: Demonstrate your ability to present findings to non‑technical stakeholders.

milestones.title: Job search and networking
milestones.outcome: Have applied to roles and built connections in the application security community.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn with portfolio projects
tasks.description: Add project links, descriptions, and highlight key security skills.

tasks.title: Apply to five Application Security Engineer jobs
tasks.description: Tailor each resume to emphasize the roadmap milestones and achievements.

tasks.title: Join OWASP local chapter and attend a meetup
tasks.description: Introduce yourself, share your threat‑model project, and collect contacts.

tasks.title: Reflect on interview experiences and adjust roadmap
tasks.description: Note any skill gaps revealed and plan next learning steps.
